title: Partition-Tolerant Asynchronous Mutual Credit Clearing Specification (Offline Promissory Note)
description: Cryptographically authenticated bilateral promissory note enabling decentralized resource and energy allocation across network-partitioned or air-gapped environments (AER Section 6.3). Enforces monotonic counter validation and priority netting settlement upon topological network reconnection.

schema_version.description: Semantic versioning string of this formal schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

iou_id.description: Unique 32-byte cryptographic digest identifying this offline credit clearing note.

debtor_node_id.description: EVM address of the debtor autonomous node accepting liability for consumed resources.

station_id.description: EVM address of the creditor node or utility provider holding the claim.

energy_kwh.description: Quantified physical electrical energy transferred, measured in kilowatt-hours.

unit_price_credit_b.description: Atomic units of Credit B charged per unit of physical resource (1 kWh).

total_credit_b.description: Cumulative principal liability denominated in atomic Credit B units.

offline_risk_factor.description: Risk multiplier gamma_offline (>= 1.0) compensating the creditor node for network partition duration and settlement delay.

nonce.description: Strictly monotonic sequence counter maintained by the debtor node to prevent double-clearing.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds recording note creation during network partition.

expiry_timestamp.description: Maturity timestamp after which the creditor node may initiate priority netting across on-chain task inflows.

debtor_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA cryptographic signature generated by the debtor over the canonical note hash.
